what: Ada moves in her session S, then starts a session S2 and writes a version of that move's entity in S2 naming it. B holds S2 and the S2 version, not the move it names; Bo moves in S2 for the seat he holds in S. A into B takes only the parent: the S2 version is reported ENTITY_OTHER_SESSION in Ada's name under its own batch, after the SEAT_NOT_HELD of a header whose id sorts between the parent's and its own. B into A makes no crossing true and reports none. Neither the S2 version nor Bo's S2 move is admitted: an entity belongs to its session, and a seat is the pair of session and seat.
